$comment: Intended native-tool settings. Exact flags are confirmed by the adapter slices and the effective values are recorded in the freeze manifest; any setting a client cannot apply is recorded as a difference, not silently dropped.

common.session: fresh per stage, except fix and sensor repairs which resume their own implementer session by explicit session id
common.workspace: fresh Git repository per workflow copied from the frozen scaffold; dependencies preinstalled
common.home: isolated per-workflow tool home inside the worktree; no personal settings, skills, memory, hooks, MCP servers, or CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md beyond the scaffold's own
common.network: not required by the task; denied where the tool or OS isolation supports it, otherwise recorded
common.cachePolicy: no pre-warming; provider prompt caching is not controllable and is observed, not assumed; no run is labelled cold
common.osIsolation: every CLI stage launched inside src/orchestrator/isolation.ts: sandbox-exec (macOS) or bwrap (Linux); hidden: worktree, main checkout, home; readable: pinned CLI packages, Node.js; writable: tool home (+ workspace for implementing stages); outbound network open for the provider API

permissions.plan: read-only workspace; writes only the plan artifact via stdout capture
permissions.review: read-only workspace; writes only the findings artifact via stdout capture
permissions.implement: workspace-write inside the workflow workspace; may run local commands; no access to evaluator or other workflows

codex.pin: npm devDependency @openai/codex@0.169.0, run as node_modules/.bin/codex; `codex --version` must equal `codex-cli 0.169.0`

sandbox.resume: -c sandbox_mode="<mode>" (exec resume has no --sandbox/-C; process cwd is the workspace)
sandbox.underOuterSandboxExec: danger-full-access (Seatbelt cannot nest; the orchestrator's outer sandbox-exec enforces read-only/workspace-write and hides the worktree and home). Under bwrap or no outer sandbox the native mode above applies.

codex.resume: codex exec resume [same flags] <SESSION_UUID> -; --last/--all never used; non-UUID ids rejected
codex.sessions: persisted (no --ephemeral) in the per-session CODEX_HOME so fixes can resume
codex.environment: built from scratch: PATH (must include node), HOME/CODEX_HOME/TMPDIR inside the tool home, LANG, NO_COLOR, npm cache/notifier settings; no OPENAI_API_KEY/CODEX_API_KEY
codex.auth: copy of auth.json from isolated .runs/auth/codex; refreshed token written back; `codex login status` must report ChatGPT; API-key login refused

claudeCode.pin: npm devDependency @anthropic-ai/claude-code@2.1.323, run as node_modules/.bin/claude; `claude --version` must equal `2.1.323 (Claude Code)`
claudeCode.invocation: claude -p --output-format stream-json --verbose (prompt on stdin); stream-json rather than json so a killed stage keeps what it emitted and results carry model_usage_since_last_result
claudeCode.settingSources: --setting-sources "" (no user/project/local settings); managed policy still applies and is recorded by sha256 and top-level keys

tools.denied: --disallowedTools mcp__* (an explicit --tools list does not remove enterprise-managed MCP tools; --strict-mcp-config is refused when managed MCP config exists)
tools.excluded: Task/subagents, web, scheduling, worktree and workflow tools

claudeCode.permissionMode: --permission-mode default for every stage (CLAUDE_CODE_SUBPROCESS_ENV_SCRUB=1 forces default; acceptEdits is overridden with a warning) plus --permission-prompts none; allowedTools pre-approves the stage's tools
claudeCode.maxEffortLevelCap: managed settings searched for maxEffortLevel before every stage; present → runner-infrastructure-failure (effort-cap-present). Applied effort is not exposed in stream-json and is recorded as null
claudeCode.environment: built from scratch: PATH, HOME/CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR/TMPDIR inside the tool home, LANG, NO_COLOR, DISABLE_AUTOUPDATER=1, CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_NONESSENTIAL_TRAFFIC=1, CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_AUTO_MEMORY=1, CLAUDE_CODE_SUBPROCESS_ENV_SCRUB=1, npm cache/notifier settings, CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN; no ANTHROPIC_API_KEY/ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN/base URL/3P provider variables
claudeCode.auth: subscription OAuth token from `claude setup-token` stored alone in isolated .runs/auth/claude/oauth-token (0600); `claude auth status --json` must report authMethod oauth_token with no apiKeySource; API keys refused; no keychain or personal config fallback
claudeCode.isolationChecks: init event tools must be a subset of the launched toolset and permissionMode must equal the launched mode; apiKeySource must be none
claudeCode.bashSandbox: CLAUDE_CODE_SUBPROCESS_ENV_SCRUB=1 makes Claude Code's own Bash sandbox mandatory (sandbox required, no unsandboxed fallback). On Linux that sandbox runs nested inside the stage bwrap and needs bwrap and socat; the runner bootstrap installs socat. Its network bridge binds Unix sockets in TMPDIR (108-byte path limit), so under bwrap TMPDIR is the stage sandbox's private /tmp tmpfs rather than the deep tool-home temp directory, where binding fails with 'Failed to create bridge sockets'. npm run shell-preflight proves a Bash command succeeds before every campaign.
